name: California Roll
subtitle: Salmon, crab, avocado, and roe wrapped in nori
description: A concise sushi roll combining cooked salmon, crab, avocado, seasoned rice, and roe in a sheet of nori.

ingredients.preparation: sushi-grade salmon fillet 1cm thick, skinned and boned (ask your fishmonger to do this for you)

ingredients.item: tobiko (flying fish roe) or masago (capelin roe)
ingredients.preparation: alternatively black or white sesame seeds

instructions.text: Cook the salmon until it reaches 145°F in the thickest part, or is opaque and flakes easily. Cool slightly, then separate into pieces.
Place the nori sheet on a bamboo mat or clean work surface. Spread the cooked sushi rice evenly over it, leaving a small strip uncovered at one edge.
Sprinkle the roe or sesame seeds over the rice. Turn the sheet rice-side down if using an inside-out roll.
Arrange the salmon, crabmeat, avocado, and optional wasabi in a line near one edge.
Roll firmly around the filling, tucking the edge in as you go. Moisten the uncovered nori strip to seal.
Use a sharp, damp knife to cut the roll into pieces and serve.
